test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, what is the literacy rate among the male population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**82.14%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **literacy rate** among the **male population** in India has shown a **steady increase** over the years.
 
• In **2001,** it was **75.26%**, and in **2011,** it increased to **82.14%.**
